text: The GeoSensitivity for Kingston upon Hull 035B is modest at 0.62 with a mid-rank of 86 out of 168 LSOAs, based on the Geo branch location-masking SMILE. Its local spatial pattern is not significant, so no cluster is detected nearby. The model’s explanation shows stable Geo and Feature attribution (att_stability Jaccard 1.0). Note, GeoSensitivity is separate from latitude (0.15) and longitude effects (-0.04), and causality is not established.
